name: Mobile App Engineer (React Native)

experience.title: Full Stack Engineer - Contract
achievements: Built Paka, a cross-platform logistics mobile app using React Native and Expo, published to Google Play with 10,000+ downloads and a 99.5% crash-free rate.
Integrated Stripe and Google Pay payment APIs, push notifications, and real-time GPS tracking into production checkout and delivery flows.
Reduced app crash rate from 15% to 0.5% through systematic performance profiling and memory leak resolution.
Managed offline data persistence using local storage and sync queues, ensuring reliable functionality during network interruptions.
Automated the CI/CD pipeline for builds and Google Play deployment, cutting release time from 45 minutes to 8 minutes.

experience.title: Full Stack / Mobile Engineer
achievements: Architected core mobile modules using React Native TurboModules, building a high-speed native bridge for cryptographic operations.
Implemented Zustand and Context API for global state management, eliminating data drift across multi-tier app layouts.
Established low-latency WebSocket connections supporting 50,000+ monthly transactions while sustaining 60fps rendering under heavy load.
Collaborated with QA and design teams to ship pixel-perfect, tested components across iOS and Android viewports.

experience.title: Software Developer
achievements: Delivered secure e-commerce mobile interfaces supporting 2,000+ daily transactions with integrated custom payment workflows.
Debugged and resolved production issues across Android and iOS builds, improving app stability ahead of major releases.
